name: mirage
text: First pass of the audit is in research/api_waste_audit_2026-10-22.md. Fixed and live on main (engine restarting onto it): PinnWire/pinnapi are now asked for a league only when SharpAPI's pushed Pinnacle price is missing, so your extra keys will only pay for what nothing else carries. Other findings: SGO, Unabated, Kalshi, SX, Polymarket, BoltOdds and SharpAPI are flat-rate (no credit waste). PropLine is on pace (12.3k of 25k with the UTC day 90% gone). Your 2 pinnapi keys are refused (HTTP 403), so replace or remove them. Still open: 6 of 21 Odds API keys are at 0 and its call count (8.7k) doesn't match its credit spend, so I'm checking what those calls are; the free ParlayAPI keys are 92-96% spent for the month (CH57b: cut the purposes other feeds already serve).
